levels = null hoac khong co -> dung so tang trong OSM, neu OSM cung khong co thi mac dinh 2 tang (nho: 1 tang). Moi tang cao 3.6 m.
height (m) uu tien hon levels. facade: white | maroon | concrete | plain.
facade_by_side: {"N":"maroon","S":"white","E":...,"W":...} theo huong mat tuong (Bac la phia tren ban do). Chua dung vi chua biet mat nao do dom.
